mapper.select: select *, (select me_name from member where me_num = cl_tc_me_num)as me_name from class where cl_able="요청";

SELECT c.cl_num, c.cl_title, c.cl_item, c.cl_intro, c.cl_money, c.cl_date, c.cl_level, c.cl_able, c.cl_tc_me_num, m.me_name, s.sc_name, t.th_picture AS cl_th_picture FROM class c JOIN subcategory s ON s.sc_cl_num = c.cl_num JOIN member m ON c.cl_tc_me_num = m.me_num LEFT JOIN thumbnail t ON c.cl_num = t.th_cl_num WHERE s.sc_ca_num = #{ca_num} and CL_ABLE="Y"

select class.*, (select me_nick from member where me_num = cl_tc_me_num)as me_name,th_picture as cl_th_picture from class left join thumbnail on th_cl_num = cl_num where cl_num in (select sc_cl_num from subcategory where sc_ca_num = #{ca_num}) and cl_able = "Y";

select class.*, (select me_nick from member where me_num = cl_tc_me_num)as me_name,th_picture as cl_th_picture from class left join thumbnail on th_cl_num = cl_num where cl_able="Y" ORDER BY cl_num DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT cl.*, COUNT(su.su_cl_num) AS mostClass,me_nick as me_name ,th_picture as cl_th_picture FROM class cl join member on me_num = cl_tc_me_num left join thumbnail on th_cl_num = cl_num LEFT JOIN subscribe su ON su.su_cl_num = cl.cl_num where cl_able="Y" GROUP BY cl.cl_num ORDER BY mostClass desc limit 8;
